Package gui

Class Icons

java.lang.Object
gui.Icons
public final class Icons extends Object
tiny vector-icon factory for the GoNature client.

replaces OS-dependent emoji (which render as thin monochrome glyphs on Windows JavaFX) with crisp SVGPath shapes drawn on a 24×24 grid. colour comes from CSS via the ikon-stroke / ikon-fill classes (theme-adaptive pine → mint in dark mode) or ikon-cream (fixed warm-cream for icons sitting on the dark-pine header/hero surfaces), so every icon follows the active palette with no per-icon wiring.

    • sized

      private static javafx.scene.Node sized(javafx.scene.shape.SVGPath p, double size)
      scales the 24-grid path to the requested size. the path is wrapped in a Group because a Group's layout bounds include its children's transforms; a bare scaled SVGPath would keep its unscaled layout bounds and misalign next to text.
